items.title: Button
items.summary: FDS action control with primary, secondary, tertiary, and danger tones.
accessibility: Use visible action text or provide an accessible name.
Loading and aria-disabled states block activation without removing the accessible name.
Use one primary action per action area.

items.title: List and review
items.summary: Approved fake-data workflow for finding records, reviewing status, and opening work that needs attention.
accessibility: Keep page heading, summary, filters, results, and pagination in reading order.
Give the results table and pagination specific accessible labels.
Preserve empty results as an explicit state.

items.title: Codex FDS prototype
items.summary: Bounded prompt for an FDS Storybook prototype using fake freight data only.
accessibility: Show applicable status, loading, empty, and error states.
Keep the workflow keyboard-operable and visibly labelled.
items.fakeDataRestriction: Use bundled or newly authored synthetic freight data only. Never include production, customer, shipment, invoice, finance, credential, or other sensitive data.
items.prompt:
# Codex Prototype Prompt

Use this prompt to request a FDS UI prototype after the component API exists.

```text
Create a Storybook prototype for [workflow name] using only FDS UI components from `@fr8labs/ui`.

Context:
- Product area: [shipment / invoice / approval / document / report]
- User role: [ops / accounting / manager]
- Main task: [task]
- Data: use fake freight data only

Rules:
- Import from `@fr8labs/ui` only.
- Do not add another UI runtime.
- Use dense but legible ERP layout.
- Show relevant status, loading, empty, and error states.
- Do not create production app code.
- Keep the story focused on this workflow only.
```

items.title: Blue 600

accessibility: Consume this primitive through an approved semantic token.
White on the semantic primary action resolves to 5.13:1 contrast.
items.permittedUsage: Primitive reference only; product and component CSS use the semantic --fds-color-action-primary alias.

instructions: Wrap the application with FdsProvider once.
Use Button through the public @fr8labs/ui export.
Copy the approved snapshot for component.button and record source FDS version 0.1.1.
Keep the source item ID in the copied file header.
